Guidance & outlook: We commenced FY27 on a strong note, delivering our highest ever quarterly revenue and EBITDA, with consolidated revenue growing 28% YoY.
I think last call we had guided for around 15% sort of revenue growth in FY27, but in Q1 itself I think we registered a growth of around 28%.
Our target is to keep growing the export business, while the domestic business is also growing, so generally the percentage remains around between 23 %-24%- 25%.
Growth & demand: The quarter witnessed strong growth across each of our core business segments, with the HPPC, TSC, and AHN business all growing by around 28% YoY.
80.6 crore, representing a growth of 18.7% YoY and making our highest ever quarterly EBITDA.
The YoY growth in terms of volume v/s price, the volume has grown by about 10% and the rest of the growth has mostly come out of the higher pricing.
Margins & costs: Divyansh, if you see the EBITDA margins, we are currently at about 11.6%, close to what we did in the last quarter and slightly lower than our last year's margin.
In terms of EBITDA margins if you see it will release at least 2%-3% EBITDA.
One question on the margin ex of the retail, if I look at the institutional margin, last year we did what 16% margin, we are now at 15.8% to 13.6%.
Capex & expansion: During the quarter, we further strengthened our presence in Southeast Asia through a greenfield blending plant in Thailand.
Regarding the ramp-up, if you see our sales has grown consistently higher and this is also due to the new capacity and new products which have come in the expansion.
If you see our EO capacity now is practically 100% utilized except for a small addition in the batch reactors.

I think at least for the next couple of quarters, we should just wait and see how the margins improve because now we also have a lot of pressure in terms of the pricing, the raw material volatility.
But given also during the volatility and uncertainty in the market, it is very difficult to predict anything today.

286 crore, up 8% YoY, while EBITDA margin stood at 11.9% compared to 12.7% in FY25.
70 crore CAPEX for FY27 and part of it is going for the pharma facility.
Growth & demand: For the full year, we delivered revenue growth of 15%, which was primarily volume driven.
From a segment perspective, HPPC delivered growth of 18 % during the quarter, Textiles grew by 20% and AHN recorded a growth of 14%.

For example if you see in the last 6 years, we have grown 25% CAGR in sales and we have grown 18% CAGR in profits and that would majorly come from repeat sales, but also getting new customers, but also getting new products in the existing customers.
Margins & costs: 77.3 crore, up 11% YoY with an EBITDA margin of 11.3% compared to 12% in the corresponding period last year.
Also, March saw some raw material price increases, some of them were to the tune of 25% to 30%, which impacted the costs.

Secondly, on the margins so you have guided for 12% to 13% margin on a consol basis, but we have seen the margins kind of drop quarter - on-quarter this year for FY26, and you did alluded for that kind of like a mix change we had, we also had raw material price increase.
Capex & expansion: On the manufacturing front, Unitop commissioned additional ethoxylation capacity at Dahej taking the total installed ethoxylation capacity to 66,000 metric tons per annum.
However, as Reliance revised its capacity expansion plans, we also moderated our capex spend.
